Requirements can vary by transaction or lender. Breeze Pest Control can inspect accessible areas and communicate findings to help buyers better understand the property.

faqs.q: Can older homes benefit from termite inspections in Pensacola, FL without visible damage?
faqs.a: Yes. The absence of obvious damage does not necessarily reveal what may be occurring in less visible areas. Breeze Pest Control performs inspections based on accessible property conditions rather than waiting for significant visible evidence to appear.
